stem: How does the use of flashback in paragraphs 2 through 9 contribute to the plot of the story “The Antique Shop”?

options.label: A
options.text: It explains why Jesse wants to spend more time away from the shop.

options.label: B
options.text: It causes Jesse to remember that he once loved the treasures in the shop.

options.label: C
options.text: It helps Jesse see that he is lucky to work at the shop owned by his family.

options.label: D
options.text: It encourages Jesse to learn more about the value of different antiques.
